name: Resort status
description: A ski resort's live status page: the morning snow report, lifts whose status and queues flip as they change, runs by difficulty, webcams, a trail map and pass prices.

props.name: webcams
props.type: { src: string; name: string; altitude: string; time: string }[]
props.description: Up to four webcam frames, each with the camera's name, altitude and the time the frame was taken. Without any, the webcam section is left out.

props.name: trailMap
props.description: Image drawn under the trail map, such as a contour map of the mountain. Without one the map sits on a plain well.

props.name: forecaster
props.type: { name: string; role?: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: Who wrote the morning report, shown under its note.

props.name: live
props.description: Play a scripted run of lift changes every few seconds: queues flip on split-flap digits, statuses flip over, and the open counts in the report follow. Pauses while the tab is hidden.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
